scenarioCoverage.measurement: Authenticated navigation, Lighthouse audits and recorded shell/content/authentication checks for the listed jobs.
scenarioCoverage.limitation: Only the inventoried role/locale/device/data scenarios are covered. Navigation measurements do not assert exhaustive CRUD, permission-matrix or business-workflow coverage. Owned-request identities are omitted.

omissions.safeSelectorPolicy: Standard element names, combinators and positional pseudo-classes only; IDs, classes and attributes removed.
omissions.auditOutcomes: Every audit outcome is retained. Unknown audit IDs receive an opaque alias. Image audits retain outcome metadata only.
omissions.errors: Known Lighthouse or runner error codes and presence/counts are retained. Free-form error and warning text is omitted explicitly.
omissions.details: Only allowlisted numeric measurements, structural containers and simplified selectors are retained.
omissions.authentication: Before/after proof retains only known roles, HTTP status codes, booleans and UTC observation/expiry times. Planned real renewal retains its fixed reason, times and success; identities and credentials are omitted.
omissions.note: A privacy-filtered derivative, not a raw Lighthouse report. Consult the separately protected raw report by its SHA-256 for omitted private details.
